verdict.rationale: Jitsu documents a public Management API, an HTTP API for managing workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions, with an OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api. Programmatic access uses personal or named API tokens, and a separate HTTP API handles data ingestion. The probe's 404s were on guessed spec paths, not the documented reference location, so they do not contradict the claim. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the API, and a machine-readable OpenAPI spec verified at a fetchable URL.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: A public Management API for every Jitsu instance, with a full OpenAPI 3.0 reference at docs.jitsu.com/api.
Jitsu exposes an HTTP API for managing workspaces, sites, destinations, connections, syncs and functions.
You can use HTTP API to send data to Jitsu.
